BEN.note: Document states nothing on electronic authentication.
No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.
Only a count of 130,000 people helped by an NGO in nine communes, not a national enrolment count or share.
No number at birth is stated.
Operation and ownership of the system are not stated beyond ANIP issuing the cards.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: La Nation reports that the Cip and the C'est Moi card are issued by ANIP to people enrolled in RAVIP, and that over 130,000 people obtained a Cip through an NGO campaign between September 2025 and May 2026.

systems.system: C'est Moi card and Certificat d'identification personnelle (Cip)
